name: Disneyland Hotel Tangaroa Terrace Tonkotsu Ramen, Teriyaki Chicken & White Rice or Macadamia-Free Pancakes
brandOrRestaurant: Tangaroa Terrace Tropical Bar & Grill (Disneyland Hotel · Disneyland Resort)
whyItWorks: Right by the Disneyland Hotel pool (next to Trader Sam's), Tangaroa Terrace serves soothing Tonkotsu Ramen with soft wheat noodles, slow-roasted Kalua Pork or Teriyaki Chicken over steamed white rice, and thick fluffy Japanese-style soufflé pancakes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: For lunch/dinner, order the Teriyaki Chicken/Kalua Pork & White Rice or Tonkotsu Ramen (no green onions or chili oil); for breakfast, order the American Breakfast (eggs, bacon, potatoes) or Thick Fluffy Pancakes with **NO macadamia nuts**.
watchOuts: Always ask for NO macadamia nuts on the Japanese pancakes and skip the spicy Poke Bowl
